assets.prompt: A calm, precise, restrained male founder voice, plain and exact, quietly confident, enterprise register, unhurried, no hype and no exclamation. The head of product delivering demo narration. Render as TWO sittings recorded a week apart in a glass-walled meeting room: SITTING 1 recorded CLOSE to the mic at a fuller, slightly louder, warmer level; SITTING 2 recorded a week later noticeably FURTHER from the mic at a quieter, thinner, more distant level with more room in it. assets.content:
VERBATIM SCRIPT:

[SITTING 1 — close mic, fuller and slightly louder level]
This is SentinelMesh. It reduces human cyber risk in real time, without slowing anyone down. It watches for the risky moment as it happens. When the risk score climbs, the platform catches it before a person clicks. Then it runs an adaptive simulation, right there, in the flow of work.

[SITTING 2 — recorded a week later, further from the mic, quieter and thinner]
And it coaches the person in the moment, with a short card they can act on. For regulated teams, every coaching interaction is logged and reportable — [HVAC SWELL BEGINS HERE, mid-sentence, rising under the rest of this clause] the part your auditor asks about first. It works alongside the stack you already run, with no agent to install. Catch the risky moment. Coach it away.
